items.item: Command traces capture discrete buttons, but movement and aim are still mostly absent even though those are the inputs a future replay runner needs most.
items.recipe: Add a tiny throttled trace sampler in App.jsx that records movement octants and aim octants only when buckets change or every bounded interval, keeping the 240-event cap intact.
items.evidence: src/App.jsx records throttled movement and aim octants through the existing command trace recorder, sampling bucket changes or interval expiry while preserving the recorder's 240-event cap.

items.item: The game can validate a trace body, but it cannot yet describe whether that body is useful evidence.
items.recipe: Extend src/utils/replayCommandTrace.js with analyzeReplayCommandTrace() returning duration, action mix, movement/aim/shoot counts, evidence level, and weakness reasons; cover rich and weak traces in unit tests.
items.evidence: src/utils/replayCommandTrace.js exports analyzeReplayCommandTrace(); replayCommandTrace tests cover rich evidence and weak low-signal traces.

items.item: validate-replay currently grants trace_contract confidence when digest/count/body shape matches, even if the body is a one-action trace that cannot support drift review.
items.recipe: Mirror the lightweight trace evidence checks in supabase/functions/validate-replay/index.ts, return heuristic rather than trace_contract for low-evidence traces, and add local tests or smoke fixture coverage for rich vs weak trace bodies.
items.evidence: supabase/functions/validate-replay/index.ts returns traceEvidence and only grants trace_contract for rich trace bodies; scripts/replay-trust-smoke.mjs now includes rich, weak, and malformed trace fixtures.
